# Scriva — AI Script Generator

> AI-powered script generator for YouTube, TikTok, VSL, podcasts, Facebook ads, cold emails, and more. Powered by GPT-4.1.

## What Scriva Does

Scriva takes a topic, script type, tone, and duration as inputs and generates a fully structured, section-labeled video or marketing script in under 10 seconds. It supports 8 script formats and 5 languages (English, Spanish, Korean, Japanese, French).

## Plans

- Free: 5 scripts/month, all 8 script types, 4 tones, copy & download
- Pro ($19/mo or $149/yr): 200 scripts/month, 5 languages, unlimited history, priority speed
